recommendations.board: Contrast priority, not a blank area, mask, crop or compositing seam
recommendations.bodyScaleStatus: nominal normal/grown authored body; real alpha shape, texture padding and motion vary
recommendations.crop: Hatched margins are cropped by the center-cover reference only. Do not place essential story details there; runtime uses focal-adjusted whole-image placement
recommendations.expanded: Expanded and accessibility canvases reflow/scroll; exported dialogue/action rectangles are geometry references, not the expanded-flow UI placement. Wide 1024×1200 uses portrait restoration art
recommendations.landmark: Place the completion landmark and recipient away from native cells, label allocations and result coverage
recommendations.propScaleStatus: starting bands, not hard quotas or a cap on whole scenery
recommendations.result: Central column up to 480 pt; height is content/Dynamic-Type dependent. Heading clearance uses the resolved scenery anchor and a 230 pt baseline; inspect actual result UI
recommendations.softBleedStatus: provisional maximum inside the perimeter, not permission to cover faces or bright silhouettes
recommendations.ui: Exported allocation rectangles, not measured glyph outlines; restoration backings add 4 pt horizontally at HUD and up to 8 pt horizontally / 4 pt vertically around guide content
recommendations.world: Build a rich connected place; continuity, supporting structures and depth remain behind all overlays
